label.zh: 开启专项「巨像计划」
label.en: Starts the "Colossus Project" special project

label.zh:
歼星级武器：
发射的热能流能够加热行星大气，并引爆行星核心，此举将彻底的毁灭星球的地壳构造。最后，一个相对较小的冲击波会将行星炸得四分五裂。
label.en:
Planet-Killer Weapon:
A directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events. A final and comparatively minute concussive blast is then delivered, cracking the planet open.

label.zh:
歼星级武器：
一个永久的、不可逾越的屏蔽场将被部署在行星表面（吸收一些波长的光）。
label.en:
Planet-Killer Weapon:
A shielding field is deployed around a planet, creating a barrier that is permanent and impenetrable (save for some wavelengths of light).

label.zh:
歼星级武器：
一种加速的中子辐射羽流将会扫过行星表面，并对大多数生物组织进行破坏。
label.en:
Planet-Killer Weapon:
An accelerated plume of neutron radiation "paints" the planet surface, severely degrading most materials and directly destroying biological tissue.

label.zh:
歼星级武器：
一个灵能投射器将圣洁真理投放到行星上，使所有有信仰的人成为正信者并消灭那些没有信仰的人。
label.en:
Planet-Killer Weapon:
A psionic projector shines divine truth upon the world to make true believers out of all who are capable of belief, and annihilating those who are not.

label.zh:
歼星级武器：
向大气中散布大量纳米机器人，它们侵入智慧生命并将自己转化为控制性的植入体，最终将不知情的宿主转化为被机械智能控制的义体人。
label.en:
Planet-Killer Weapon:
Swarms of nanobots are dispersed in the atmosphere. They infect sapient beings and restructure themselves into cybernetic implants, turning their unwitting hosts into cyborgs slaved to the Machine Intelligence.

label.zh:
歼星级武器：
这是一种巨像级心智抹除武器，可以释放覆盖整颗行星的能量波，将大多数感性生命变回未开智状态。我们估计在进行进一步调整之后，它甚至还可以用来抹除机器单元的记忆体使其瘫痪。
label.en:
Planet-Killer Weapon:
A colossal mind-wiping cannon which unleashes a planet-wide wave of energy, returning most sentient life to a pre-sapient state. We estimate that with additional tuning, it might also be used to wipe clean memory banks and disable robotic units.

label.zh:
歼星级武器：
熔炉将灼热的能量束聚焦于行星地幔，破坏其核心稳定性，引发构造混乱，令地表极度不稳定。
label.en:
Planet-Killer Weapon:
Focusing a searing energy beam into the planet's mantle, the Smelter destabilizes its core, triggering tectonic chaos and rendering the surface violently unstable.
